integrity: Two-lemma algebraic proof; standard-library literal enumeration and GF(4) arithmetic corroborate finite cases. Exact finite sum, no external certification.
scientific_limitations: Counts labeled ordered tuples for triangular chain algebras over finite fields; not conjugacy orbits, arbitrary incidence algebras, or ring-base generalizations. The accessible abstract, but not full body, of Kolegov (2024) was inspected; priority provisional.
title: Exact hypercube-weighted counts of idempotent generating tuples in finite triangular algebras
